answer: Pin each identity to one physical machine: require a secure-enclave attestation at registration, unique per device. A sybil operator spins up a thousand puppets on five servers, but the enclave whispers its secret only from real silicon — emulated or reused attestations read hollow and fail verification. Every puppet now demands its own inlet of hardware: a phone, a chip, a real cost. Duplicated device keys across identities get flagged and burned. Clone-armies stop scaling when each clone must own a body.
